findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: meta_tag_generator · Private data: jwt_decoder, file_hash, password_generator · Public sink: margin_calculator, subnet_calculator · Destructive: vat_calculator, remove_duplicates.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: meta_tag_generator · Private data: jwt_decoder, file_hash, password_generator · Public sink: margin_calculator, subnet_calculator · Destructive: vat_calculator, remove_duplicates

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
